targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(snapshot_ts_utc) AS ts FROM cluster_capacity_metrics WHERE vcenter_name = '$vcenter') SELECT coalesce(sum(total_allowed_vcpu),0) AS "vCPU Capacity" FROM cluster_capacity_metrics c JOIN latest l ON c.snapshot_ts_utc = l.ts WHERE c.vcenter_name = '$vcenter';

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(snapshot_ts_utc) AS ts FROM cluster_capacity_metrics WHERE vcenter_name = '$vcenter') SELECT coalesce(sum(total_allocated_vcpu),0) AS "vCPU Used" FROM cluster_capacity_metrics c JOIN latest l ON c.snapshot_ts_utc = l.ts WHERE c.vcenter_name = '$vcenter';

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(snapshot_ts_utc) AS ts FROM cluster_capacity_metrics WHERE vcenter_name = '$vcenter') SELECT coalesce(sum(total_usable_ram_gb),0) AS "Memory Capacity" FROM cluster_capacity_metrics c JOIN latest l ON c.snapshot_ts_utc = l.ts WHERE c.vcenter_name = '$vcenter';

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(snapshot_ts_utc) AS ts FROM cluster_capacity_metrics WHERE vcenter_name = '$vcenter') SELECT coalesce(sum(total_allocated_ram_gb),0) AS "Memory Used" FROM cluster_capacity_metrics c JOIN latest l ON c.snapshot_ts_utc = l.ts WHERE c.vcenter_name = '$vcenter';

SELECT snapshot_ts_utc AS "time", sum(total_allowed_vcpu) AS "vCPU Capacity", sum(total_allocated_vcpu) AS "vCPU Used" FROM cluster_capacity_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_ts_utc) AND vcenter_name = '$vcenter' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT snapshot_ts_utc AS "time", sum(total_usable_ram_gb) AS "Memory Capacity (GB)", sum(total_allocated_ram_gb) AS "Memory Used (GB)" FROM cluster_capacity_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_ts_utc) AND vcenter_name = '$vcenter' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT snapshot_ts_utc AS "time", cpu_used_pct AS "Cluster CPU Used %", ram_used_pct AS "Cluster RAM Used %" FROM cluster_capacity_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_ts_utc) AND vcenter_name = '$vcenter' AND cluster_name = '$cluster' ORDER BY 1;

SELECT snapshot_ts_utc AS "time", total_allowed_vcpu AS "Cluster vCPU Capacity", total_allocated_vcpu AS "Cluster vCPU Used" FROM cluster_capacity_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_ts_utc) AND vcenter_name = '$vcenter' AND cluster_name = '$cluster' ORDER BY 1;

SELECT snapshot_ts_utc AS "time", total_usable_ram_gb AS "Cluster Memory Capacity (GB)", total_allocated_ram_gb AS "Cluster Memory Used (GB)" FROM cluster_capacity_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_ts_utc) AND vcenter_name = '$vcenter' AND cluster_name = '$cluster' ORDER BY 1;

SELECT snapshot_ts_utc AS "time", cpu_used_pct AS "Host CPU Used %", ram_used_pct AS "Host RAM Used %" FROM host_capacity_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_ts_utc) AND vcenter_name = '$vcenter' AND cluster_name = '$cluster' AND compute_name = '$host' ORDER BY 1;

SELECT snapshot_ts_utc AS "time", allowed_vcpu AS "Host vCPU Capacity", allocated_vcpu AS "Host vCPU Used" FROM host_capacity_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_ts_utc) AND vcenter_name = '$vcenter' AND cluster_name = '$cluster' AND compute_name = '$host' ORDER BY 1;

SELECT snapshot_ts_utc AS "time", usable_ram_gb AS "Host Memory Capacity (GB)", allocated_ram_gb AS "Host Memory Used (GB)" FROM host_capacity_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_ts_utc) AND vcenter_name = '$vcenter' AND cluster_name = '$cluster' AND compute_name = '$host' ORDER BY 1;

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(snapshot_ts_utc) AS ts FROM datastore_capacity_metrics WHERE vcenter_name = '$vcenter') SELECT coalesce(sum(capacity_tb),0) AS "Datastore Capacity (TB)", coalesce(sum(used_tb),0) AS "Datastore Used (TB)" FROM datastore_capacity_metrics d JOIN latest l ON d.snapshot_ts_utc = l.ts WHERE d.vcenter_name = '$vcenter';
SELECT snapshot_ts_utc AS "time", used_pct AS "Used %" FROM datastore_capacity_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_ts_utc) AND vcenter_name = '$vcenter' AND datastore_name = '$datastore' ORDER BY 1;
